AUD-001Implemented

Tenant-scoped append-only hash-chained audit events

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Compliance Assurance

Acceptance boundary

Tenant-scoped append-only hash-chained audit events is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Executable first-party controls and automated evidence exist for AUD-001; production operation still depends on institution configuration and monitored deployment.

Review currency

Last reviewed 2026-07-15. Revalidate when implementation, policy, provider or operating evidence changes.

AUD-002Partial

End-to-end API, UI, domain, decision and integration actor/session/role/correlation provenance

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Compliance Assurance

Acceptance boundary

Every material API, UI, domain, decision and provider action can be traced to the originating human, borrower, agent or service identity and current delegation without trusting a client-supplied human actor.

Current maturity and gap

Tenant API requests and wired dashboard/borrower screens are attributable today. Universal UI coverage, provider correlation propagation, SIEM export and missing-event reconciliation remain.

Dependencies

AUD-001

Review currency

Last reviewed 2026-07-15. Revalidate when implementation, policy, provider or operating evidence changes.

Implementation and verification evidence 3
  • codeapps/api/src/server.js

    Authenticated request and bounded screen events carry principal, session/credential/delegation, request and pseudonymised client/network attribution in a separate tenant activity hash chain.

  • testtests/saas-identity-governance-api.test.js

    HTTP evidence joins an authenticated screen event and API request to the exact human session.

  • docdocs/architecture/tenant-role-staffing-and-feature-gating.md

    Forensic activity schema, privacy limits and cross-system correlation target.
